title: Season Canvas 2026
intro: Create public seasons and follow their progress.
sessionError: We could not verify your sign-in status. Try again.

list.empty: There are no seasons with this status.

detail.title: Season information
detail.notFound: This season could not be found or is not accessible.

manage.cancelDescription: Cancelling {{title}} removes it from the public list and cannot be undone.
manage.endDescription: Ending {{title}} now cannot be undone. The scheduled end remains in its record.

form.title: Create New Season
form.description: Set capacity, entry rules, and an optional SOL entry fee. The creator uses one capacity slot.
form.feeNote: Participants pay this fee to your signed-in wallet when they join. Fees are not refunded.
form.durationNote: Ends automatically at the end time. As host, you can also end it early.
form.timezone: Times are shown in your browser time zone ({{timezone}}).
form.ambiguous: We cannot tell whether the server created this season. The request will not retry automatically.
form.retryAck: I understand that retrying may create a duplicate season.

errors.integerRange: Enter a whole number within the shown range.
errors.entryFeeRange: Enter 0.001 to 100 SOL with up to 9 decimal places.
errors.titleLength: Enter 1 to 50 characters after trimming spaces.
errors.descriptionLength: Enter no more than 1000 characters after trimming spaces.
errors.invalidDateTime: Choose a valid local date and time.
errors.scheduledStartRange: Choose a future time within 30 days.
errors.durationRange: Choose an end 1 hour to 30 days after the start.
errors.immediateDurationRange: Choose an end 61 minutes to 30 days from now.

errors.inputInvalid: Check the values and try again.
errors.sessionInvalid: Your sign-in expired. Sign in again from the header.
errors.originNotAllowed: The service connection is not configured correctly. Contact the operator.
errors.userUnavailable: This account cannot perform that action.
errors.activeLimit: You can have up to three scheduled and active seasons combined.
errors.ownerRequired: The current signed-in user cannot manage this season.
errors.stateConflict: The season status changed. Review the latest information.
errors.notFound: This season could not be found or is not accessible.
errors.unavailable: The request result is unclear. Refresh the latest information.
errors.unknown: The request could not be completed. Check the latest information shortly.
errors.capacityReached: This season is full. Existing participants keep their place.
errors.walletMismatch: You joined this season with a different wallet. Sign in with that wallet.
errors.entryFeeUnavailable: Entry fee payments are temporarily unavailable. Try again shortly.
errors.walletSigning: The wallet did not sign the entry fee payment. No SOL was sent.
errors.paymentExpired: The payment request expired before it was confirmed. Try again.
errors.paymentFailed: The entry fee transaction failed. Check your wallet balance and try again.
errors.paymentPending: Your payment is still being confirmed. Try again in a moment to finish joining.
